name: SPECTRA-IV
description: A set of benchmark spectral data derived from LIB-IV intended for validating and comparing spectral analysis methods.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (e.g., RMSE/MSE for parameter estimation; precision/recall/F1 for classification/line identification)
reputation: Established within the spectral-analysis and astronomy communities as a validation set for spectral-method development, though not broadly used as a general ML benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; dataset may be instrument- and scenario-specific, requiring careful preprocessing and calibration; potential small-sample issues for some classes of spectra.
